name: 龙骨鬼
desc: 和这张卡进行战斗的怪兽是战士族·魔法师族的场合，伤害步骤结束时那只怪兽破坏。
faq: If "Ryu Kokki" battles with "Dark Magician of Chaos", "Ryu Kokki" is destroyed and removed from play by "Dark Magician of Chaos"' effect, and "Dark Magician of Chaos" is removed from play because it is destroyed by "Ryu Kokki"'s effect and removed by its own effect.
